33.proof: A seven-vertex graph has a K7 minor only if it is K7: seven nonempty disjoint branch sets must all be singleton. Identification here gives K7 minus edge 01, hence destroys K7-minor existence. This does not contradict Hadwiger because vertices 0 and 1 can share a color.

35.proof: If tree vertex 0 is sent to universal vertex 15, a vertex at depth two would have to be nonadjacent to 15, which is impossible. Nevertheless vertices 0 through 14 induce the complete binary tree. Thus one failed rooted search is not a certificate of induced-tree absence. The host has clique number and chromatic number three.
